mapper.sql: id, record_no, task_id, professional_type_id, professional_type_name, module_id, module_name, responsibility_id, responsibility_name, issue_id, issue_name, quality_id, quality_name, problem_type, problem_description, location, suggestion, department_id, check_unit_id, check_unit_name, nature_modified, responsible_unit, responsible_person, photos, rectification_date, rectification_suggestion, rectification_effect, rectification_images, rectification_time, review_suggestion, review_effect, review_images, review_time, inspector, safety_score, record_status, record_edit_audit_type, modify_description, modify_user_id, modify_user_name, modify_time, modification_snapshot, create_user_id, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, COALESCE(qd.dict_label, r.quality_name) AS quality_name, u.real_name as create_user_name, resp_dept.dept_name as responsibility_name, d.dept_name as department_name, t.task_no as task_no, t.task_name as task_name, DATE_FORMAT(t.inspection_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as inspection_time, r.rectification_date as rectification_deadline FROM sys_monthly_inspection_record r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.create_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept resp_dept ON r.responsibility_id = resp_dept.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON r.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN sys_monthly_inspection_task t ON r.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN sys_dictionary qd ON qd.dict_value = r.quality_id AND qd.dict_type = '性质界定' AND qd.deleted = 0 WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_monthly_inspection_record WHERE create_user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT record_no FROM sys_monthly_inspection_record WHERE record_no IS NOT NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT record_status as status, COUNT(*) as count FROM sys_monthly_inspection_record WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY record_status
